audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows gave the level to Mordekaiser on both layers — including Level 1, where the page's own whys[0] says his turrets wall you off the wave and you 'just eat chip while last-hitting'. The chart said 8/10 in your favour on a 47.85% matchup already marked HARD.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Skill / Heimerdinger / Mordekaiser / Skill / Heimerdinger and the mirror has already flipped to it. Every content why already argued Heimerdinger's case; only the side tokens and ratings disagreed.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3 and 6 set to Heimerdinger and row 2 to Skill as one atomic group across both layers, ratings dropped to 3/10, 3/10, 5/10, 4/10, 3/10. Level 6 stays Mordekaiser at 8/10 and First item stays Skill. phases[2].why, phases[3].why and phases[6].why rewritten to argue their new side.

audit.why: The spike list is honest and already shaped right for this lane: Heimerdinger owns 1-3, level 3 is your one early window, level 6 is the Realm, and first item onward is his again. Nothing to move.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names a second ability called 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade'. No such Heimerdinger ability exists — his E is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, and the same line already lists it. The packet also flags that the full layer never names any of his real abilities. No cooldowns anywhere.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is 11 seconds flat at every rank, and Riot's text distinguishes the direct hit (stun) from the surrounding units (slow only) — so the grenade is survivable if you take the edge, which is the difference between a lost engage and a completed one. Micro-Rockets are 11/10/9/8/7 at 1325 range, which is why you cannot answer from outside. The turret is a 1-second cooldown, so clearing one buys seconds.
audit.corrected: Fabricated name removed; real names and cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, phases[2].why and phases[3].why, with the direct-hit-versus-splash distinction stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track his grenade before every engage' with no duration, next to a 140-second ultimate with no duration either.
audit.why: The two numbers that decide this lane are 11 seconds and 140 seconds. An 11s grenade means the window comes back constantly; a 140s R means you get roughly one attempt per wave cycle and cannot spend it clearing a nest.
audit.corrected: 11s into dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns; 140s into dontsFull[1].d.

edits.before: Full kit plus Darkness Rise — three hits sets your aura burning and the lane flips. E-drag Heimerdinger off his wave and run the Q-auto-E pattern on every CH-2 Grenade (Stun) cooldown.
edits.after: Darkness Rise ignites and the footing levels out. CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is 11s flat — inside that gap, Death's Grasp him off the turret line and run the pattern.

edits.before: Q ranks make isolated hits massive. Heimerdinger must hug minions all lane; punish every step away from the wave with the full drag combo.
edits.after: Q ranks hit hard but he never leaves the turret line — without a clean Death's Grasp he rockets you down from 1325 range for free.

edits.before: Riftmaker omnivamp turns the Realm 1v1 unloseable into most matchups. Heimerdinger's only outs are dodging Q forever or never being alone — neither survives a whole game.
edits.after: The Realm 1v1 still deletes him, but a full-AP Heimerdinger out-zones the sidelane from behind upgraded turrets — take him in fights, never in a farm war.

edits.before: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade (Stun): matchup-defining — His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Heimerdinger CH-3X Lightning Grenade: Lobs a grenade that slows, and stuns at the center. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E): 11s flat at every rank — a direct hit stuns, the splash only slows, so eat the edge not the centre. - Hextech Micro-Rockets (W): 11s at rank 1, 1325 range. - H-28 G Evolution Turret (Q): 1s cooldown.

edits.before: His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: The grenade is 11s flat at every rank — only a direct hit stuns you.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Realm of Death is 140s at rank 1 — spend it on him, not on his nest.

notes: 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade' in breakdown.cooldowns was a genuine fabricated ability name — it is not in Heimerdinger's kit at all, and the packet's name-checker did not catch it because it only flagged wants.you[2]. That flagged item ('Bank Indestructible') is a false positive: Indestructible is Mordekaiser's real W with a verb in front. Left alone but worth a pass: focus.text and roughly twenty generated strings call his E 'CH-2 Grenade (Stun)' rather than its real name, CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade. That is a champion-wide generated-string pattern rather than a per-matchup error, and changing focus.text alone would leave the twenty derived strings inconsistent. Not asserted anywhere, because neither kit answers it: whether Heimerdinger's deployed turrets persist or follow when you pull him into Realm of Death. The page currently claims the realm has 'no turrets', which is plausible but unverified — flagged in questionsForUser.
